At natural qualified mainloop contact stops only, validate PAR5=$34 and read ENTITY_COUNT*4 bytes (maximum 48) from physical page $34 at mapped ENTITY_TABLE=$A380. Preserve the JSON-safe bytes/hash and source-qualified marker, then filter the existing input-only driver at prospective centers and step-3 in-flight direction; malformed mapping/count/coordinates fail closed.

After each natural held-input final release join, run a separate 45-second neutral ordinary-enemy-release-roam phase. A success marker requires source-qualified mainloop state with ENEMY_RELEASED increased from the cached phase baseline, ENEMY_ACTIVE consistent with source-tagged occupied rows, at least one active row outside (12,12), and saved-background-valid=1. This marker does not count as an enemy contact.

For death-blank qualification, bind the 14 authored death frames and resident sparse streams to the complete current receipt, compiler, map, listing, and staged image. At committed state-1/2 FRONT, compare exact compiled death art over that owner’s saved-under pixels and retain a private owner-local pose by contact and entry generation. At the qualified timer-37 blank IRQ, use that FRONT owner’s PLAYER_OLD_FB retired pointer, independently retain current PLAYER_FB/metadata, and require unchanged save-under bytes and exact restored FRONT pixels. Missing history, changed source/staged/CPU/physical bytes, stale generation, wrong owner/metadata/mapping, or missing IRQ remains fail-closed; public evidence omits raw pixel snapshots.
observer_adapter.natural_route: Natural-only: the existing four input-only bindings remain held across legal pose progress and rotate only after eight repeated unchanged step-0 observations. At source-qualified mainloop stops, decode the bounded page-$34 ENTITY_TABLE snapshot and avoid active skull cells at the next center and at a step-3 in-flight move. A malformed or unavailable snapshot fails closed. No planner, guest-state write, forced enemy state, or deadline extension is added.
observer_adapter.run_stop_control: Maintained synchronous run acknowledgement followed by bounded wait_for_stop and exact read_registers PC; buffered breakpoint-before-ack notifications are rechecked as actual stops.
observer_adapter.forced_order_entry: front-first and music-first runs use ordinary input-only route search through two genuine contacts and replacements, then write only at lives=0 / HUD marker column x=33 (pixel x=264) / row-derived player x=320.
observer_adapter.natural_held_input_challenge: At first state 2 of each natural initial/replacement entry, hold the live South binding translated from $0287 matrix identity to DSCAN. Audit all automatic logical poses, direction/facing, and actual FRONT poses through states 2/3/4. Release only in final state-4 wait after the entry's terminal post-PSG busy-zero and IRQ-committed final FRONT proofs. Require three entry witnesses and zero target RAM writes; forced fixtures do not run this challenge.
observer_adapter.bootstrap_reset_stores: Source-derived from current complete receipt, bootstrap source/listing/map, staged boot image, and packaged ROM raw bank-zero prefix; watched reset events remain separate from runtime cue-owned PSG events.

natural_contact_waypoint_discriminator.route_scope: existing input-only bindings and hold/waypoint semantics only; no new planner, module, protocol, guest-state writes, forced enemy state, or deadline extension
natural_contact_waypoint_discriminator.classification_limit: Observed no progress does not prove a wall blockage. A collectible/vegetable pause, enemy freeze, or other game-state cause remains unresolved; retain timer/enemy snapshots and report uncertainty without attributing cause.
natural_contact_waypoint_discriminator.hazard_entity_table: At source-qualified natural mainloop in contact phase, require PAR5 masked=$34 and ENTITY_TABLE=$A380, count 1..12, 4-byte records, x/y<24; retain at most 48 bytes plus SHA-256. Entity type 1 is the skull hazard. Check the prospective next cell at step 0 and PLAYER_DIR in-flight at step 3; never inject if all adjacent cells are skulls.
natural_contact_waypoint_discriminator.ordinary_release_marker: Separate neutral 45-second phase after the entry held-input release join; require ENEMY_RELEASED greater than the cached phase baseline, ENEMY_ACTIVE equal to occupied source-tagged rows, and an active outside-nest (not 12,12) row with saved-background-valid=1 at qualified mainloop.
